redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages, specifications, catalogs or viewers retained as references; access does not imply row or artifact redistribution rights.
An exact artifact whose declared licence or permission permits recorded fields and derivatives, with provider, edition, coverage, schema, CRS, validity, attribution, obligations and digest pinned.
Registered, request-delivered, paid, licensed, credentialed or restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Personal, query, unclear-license, search-only, viewer-only or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.provider: Bahrain Post, Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications
sources.production_scope: The official directory publishes post-office names, public addresses and three- or four-digit locality postcodes. A pinned example can validate display and an office address, but the directory is not a complete postcode-block allocation table, history, polygon, delivery entitlement or blanket bulk licence.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union with Bahrain Post
sources.production_scope: The January 2024 UPU sheet defines format, position, range and home/P.O. box examples. It is addressing metadata, not a complete current assignment database, postcode-block crosswalk, subscriber directory or building relation.

iGA issues, modifies and deletes official building addresses and unit or establishment numbers. Exact permitted public identifiers can support an explicit relation. CPR, owners, occupants, residents, tenants, deeds, applications, contacts and controlled certificate results are excluded.

The October 2025 portal terms permit royalty-free reuse on this site and linked iGA-owned sites with source/date attribution, transformation notice, a prescribed disclaimer, sublicence propagation and removal on iGA request. The portal also links the May 2025 government open-data licence, whose scope includes officially published government open datasets on other government sites. Exact applicability and all obligations remain artifact-specific; neither document releases controlled records or all government content.

sources.provider: Information and eGovernment Authority GIS Department, Bahrain
sources.production_scope: The inspected April 2026 dataset contains 27 selected public-landmark points with 20 distinct block labels and four governorate labels. It has no explicit postcode field or civic/building identifier. The metadata bbox is only an envelope. Pin metadata, the portal terms, government licence, extraction date and digests; counts and matching coordinates do not establish national assignment coverage, CRS accuracy or address-building relations.

sources.provider: Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, Bahrain
sources.production_scope: The official viewer supports map exploration, area classification and roads. Exact layer terms, edition, identifiers, schema, CRS, topology and digest are required before any feature reuse. Viewer access alone is not vector permission, postal assignment or legal survey.

sources.provider: Survey and Land Registration Bureau, Bahrain
sources.production_scope: SLRB is the authoritative cadastral survey and property-boundary provider, including requested or paid products. A permitted parcel may support candidates but is not a postcode block, building footprint or address relation. CPR, owners, title deeds, rights, restrictions and application records are excluded.

sources.provider: Government of Bahrain / Information and eGovernment Authority
sources.production_scope: Version 1.0, 20 May 2025, covers officially published government open datasets on the portal or other government sites. It preserves attribution/date, transformation, disclaimer, sublicence, removal and privacy conditions and excludes personal, confidential and restricted data. Applicability does not turn a viewer or controlled certificate into an open dataset.
